description: Pilot private-input predicate: 16 committed reserve slots, tagged by the eight GENIUS Act 4(a)(1)(A) categories, must cover the committed payment stablecoins outstanding. OCG section 25: inputs are sha256-salted@1 commitments, the receipt holds only the yes/no verdict. Integer only, no haircut, witness is 16 slots of 20 digits. Not proof reserves exist, are unencumbered, approved, or free of 4(a)(2) rehypothecation, nor the Act monthly report. Proof deferred; result is a preview, not a receipt.

cited_clause_digest.clause_path: GENIUS Act (Pub. L. 119-27) Sec. 4(a)(1)(A) -- reserves at least 1 to 1 against outstanding payment stablecoins; permitted reserve categories (i) to (viii)

deferred_reason: New gpu:false private-input node, art-809-check-reserves-cover-outstanding-private, authored 2026-11-03. Exec-only measure on the section 25 private-input guest (PRIVATE-PREDICATE-DESIGN-1, prototype of this kernel): MAX 9,106,901 user_cycles over 58 segments, FAST class under the 30M ceiling; proving is the separate PRIVATE-PREDICATE-PROVE-1 row, which needs its SIDEBYSIDE row first (SO #39). Deferred per the section 18 steady-state rule (RIDER-KERNEL.md).
